description: OmniAccelerANT's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json); the one line below is the whole adoption.

The shared preset enables Renovate's git-submodules manager for reports. The local driver independently checks all four direct gitlinks (ANThology, ANTfrastructure, OxidANT, AccelerANTgine) and follows each remote default branch, even if .gitmodules names another branch or Renovate omits a row.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. The Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09), so no bot will ever land a commit here - but this file is not idle: ANTfrastructure's linux/scripts/renovate-local.sh reads exactly it.
Dependabot is off family-wide (owner, 2026-10-20): .github/dependabot.yml is deleted, and this file is the only dependency watch.
